name: com.orkunmanap.runtime-transform-handles
description: Runtime position, rotation, and scale gizmos for manipulating objects at play time. Supports multi-object selection, switchable pivot/center origin, world/local space, configurable snapping, and both the legacy Input Manager and the New Input System.

samples.description: Full-featured demo: spawns its own targets and exercises every handle type, axis mask, space, snapping mode, multi-object grouping, auto-scaling, and the interaction event system through an on-screen control panel.
